subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Heracles in <Picture 1>: a bearded man in his early thirties with short curling dark hair, a scar through the left eyebrow, a lion-pelt cloak with the lion's head hood pushed back, a linen tunic, leather wrist wraps, and a short bronze sword; soaked, with black hydra blood on his face and pelt.
<Subject 2> is the Lernaean hydra in <Picture 2>: a serpentine body rising from black water with eight viper-like necks of dark green scales, and a ninth head held highest at the center, a third larger, with gold eyes and a crown of bone spikes.
<Subject 3> is the Lerna swamp at night in <Picture 3>: a muddy shore with a row of burning torch stakes, a chest-high boulder at the water's edge, black still water, reeds, dead trees, and thin mist.
<<< per-tier variable >>>

overall_soundscape:
Black swamp water sloshes and drips, hydra hisses overlap, one heavy blow lands, a torch flame flares, and burning flesh hisses; a low wind moves through the reeds.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

tiers.label: prose
tiers.note: Prose leaves the order of events to the model: check whether the fire really comes after the fall.

tiers.label: beat sheet
tiers.note: Beats give each moment a result state: watch 0-4 s for 'down in the water, hand on the stake'.

tiers.label: beat sheet + shot list
tiers.note: The shot list fixes size and angle: 4-7 s should be a close-up on the hand, and the cuts should land on 4.0 and 7.0.

tiers.label: storyboard (+ 3 frames)
tiers.note: Three attached frames on top of t3: check the torch in S9 and the profile in S10 against the boards.

packaging.note: 12.25 s 厚涂 CG 在 crf 28 仍超 1 MB（见回执 §7），收尾改 crf 26 / 上限 2.5 MB；三条分镜切片仍 crf 26 / 1 MB
